bio: Nicknamed "Mr.Headshot" for killing Sheroid with a single headshot from a distance. A bus ticket was found in his pocket on the day he was killed, suggesting he had planned to leave Chicago. Close to Dutchie.
Originally from THF 46 before joining STL/EBT. Stayed on good terms with Bayzoo and Twilla of the 4-6. Fired more than 15 shots at OTF Pat of the NLMB, who miraculously survived.
Also known as Big Chick. Assaulted Makado in prison in front of Cdai.
Killed by police while running with a firearm. His death sparked violent riots by STL/EBT members against the police.
An OG. Close to Ty.
Incarcerated for involvement in three murders.
Also known as Weezy.
Had relationships with Makado, King Von, Boss Smooth, Jiale, TuTu, and Lil Jay. Was close to Tyquan, teaching him how to shoot and run operations, and was also close to FBG Butta.
Killed Waldo 24 hours after MOB Dooski's death.
Killed Lil Nick of DukeSquad while aiming at Jusblow. The attack was intended to avenge MOB Scrapp, whom he was close to.
Was close to DukeSquad until they killed Lil Nick.
Sentenced to 43 years for a murder he didn't commit but was present at. Known for gunfights with police; MOB frequently dedicates to him for this.
Won his lawsuit and a $15 million settlement after police shot him, but was incarcerated for murder before collecting it. He turned in some MOB members for money.
Also known as Dooski Tha Man. Close to Lil Scrapp and Rooga.
Was incarcerated when Blood Money was killed. Died in 2019 at the hands of his own allies.
Part of the new MOB generation. Released from incarceration after Dooski's death, he went to shoot at O'Block the next day with another MOB member. An active shooter.
Started a war with Shields and was preparing to start one with Jaro City when he was killed a few days before he could initiate it. Had a personal conflict with Lil Steve.
Was driving on the night Junebug was killed. Received gunfire in the incident and was paralyzed for life.
Also known as Mooski.
Also known as Big Glo. Shot at rapper Shy Glizzy's tour bus. Was a mentor to Extendo Quono and close to Lil Boo.
Sentenced to 30 years for murder. Killed Junebug at age 12-13 with the help of Baldy.
Became a father before dying of an infection. Was known as one of the biggest dealers in the area.
Originally from Lamron. Close to Chief Keef, Blood Money, and Lil Herb. Paid tribute to his friend Drama hours before MTG killed him.
Also known as Ninoratchi.
Sentenced to over 25 years for murdering a child who refused to give him his jacket.
Close to Extendo Quono.
Also known as Extendo Quono and QuonaMillie. Originally a Gangster Disciple before switching to Black Disciples. Close to Fredo Santana, Nino, Boss Gottie, Blood Money, Chief Keef, Lil Boo, and DaDa.
Close to Fredo Santana and Blood Money. Now focused on his rap career.
Originally a Gangster Disciple from 757.
Originally a Gangster Disciple from 757.
From Dipset (now called Front$treet). Sentenced to over 70 years.
Also known as 4.0.
Incarcerated for murdering Big V of Tyquan World. Says everyone forgot him in prison with only a public defender. Was the first to shoot with D-Thang.
Friends with Millz of 051 Young Money. Known for shooting from a bike in the Jaro City area. Gave RondoNumba9 his nickname.
